mainClaim: Pickup has a passenger compartment and a separate open cargo bed/platform.

attempts.role: designated source open; supplementary context only, not used as authoritative proof
attempts.result: Full captured response body covers lines L0-L301 (304 lines), while page metadata says 459 total lines. It describes a cab and an uncovered cargo bed at L173, but is retained as supplementary context only.

attempts.role: single official alternative open; accepted primary evidence for the pickup definition
attempts.result: Full eCFR §523.2 text read. L195 defines a pickup as a non-passenger automobile with a passenger compartment and an open cargo area (bed). L216 defines a van as fully enclosing the driver and cargo/work compartment; L214-L215 describe a truck tractor.
